scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs');['backend','frontend'].forEach(d=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d+'/.env'))fs.copyFileSync(d+'/.env.example', d+'/.env')})"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
